message: 伝説の一枚

name: Azel
message: 「Synn. Are you ready?」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah... wait, is that really all you're bringing, Azel?!」

name: Azel
message: 「What do you mean? I have my Leica.」

name: Synn
message: 「Your Leica aside, just that tiny bag...」

name: Azel
message: 「It's fine. I packed plenty of film.」

name: Synn
message: 「B-But still, girls need a change of clothes and stuff...」

name: Azel
message: 「It's fine.」

name: Paqy
message: 「If it comes down to it, she can just buy some clothes over there, right?」

name: Synn
message: 「Well, maybe, yeah.」

name: Azel
message: 「You're such a worrywart, Synn.」
For one week starting today.
With the money the two of us saved up from working tons of part-time jobs
we're going on a trip to a southern island. The island Azel saw in a photo and muttered she wanted to visit in person.

name: Synn
message: 「Still, it's an island where the ferry only runs once every two days.」

name: Azel
message: 「It'll be fine. As long as I'm with you, I'll be okay anywhere.」
Azel's words held straightforward conviction and trust.

name: Synn
message: 「...You're right. If it's the two of us, we'll be fine.」

name: Sasami
message: 「Cluck, cluck-cluck-cluck.」

name: Synn
message: 「I asked Nanaka to take care of you, so don't cause her any trouble.」

name: Sasami
message: 「Cluck.」

name: Paqy
message: 「What about taking care of yours truly!」

name: Synn
message: 「I made sure to ask her for you too. Though I still wish you'd just come with us.」

name: Paqy
message: 「Still clueless as ever, aren't ya.」

name: Paqy
message: 「Ahem, yours truly has sensitive skin, ya see. So I can't go somewhere with such harsh sunlight, ya know.」

name: Synn
message: 「I see...」

name: Azel
message: 「Thanks. Leave Synn to me.」

name: Paqy
message: 「...Yeah.」

name: Synn
message: 「We're heading out.」

name: Azel
message: 「We're off.」

name: Paqy
message: 「Yeah. Take care.」

name: Sasami
message: 「Cluck.」
We looked up at Grand Palace Sakura.

name: Azel
message: 「I'm heading out.」

name: Synn
message: 「I'm heading out!」
We start walking.
Naturally, we're holding hands.

name: Azel
message: 「Synn.」

name: Synn
message: 「Could it be you're excited?」

name: Azel
message: 「Yeah! Can you tell?」

name: Synn
message: 「It's the first step toward your dream, after all.」
Azel's dream is to photograph the various sights of Heaven, the Demon World, and the Human World.
And to hold photo exhibitions in each of the three realms.
Right now, even traveling between them is difficult, but someday, surely someday.

name: Azel
message: 「That's right.」

name: Azel
message: 「When I was in Heaven, I had no interest in the scenery around me.」

name: Azel
message: 「But I'm sure that if I look through my eyes as they are now, there are beautiful sights to be seen.」

name: Azel
message: 「Probably in the Demon World too.」
Azel's eyes were sparkling.

name: Synn
message: 「There definitely are.」
Azel looks straight up at me.

name: Azel
message: 「And this is a dream I never could have found without you, Synn.」
I get just a little embarrassed.
And I squeeze her hand just a little tighter.

name: Azel
message: 「What's your dream, Synn?」

name: Synn
message: 「Working hard so that a world where the three worlds get along will come, I guess?」

name: Azel
message: 「Surely, our dreams may seem different, yet they're the same.」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah.」

name: Azel
message: 「It'll probably be tough until we make it happen.」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah. Even so.」

name: Synn
message: 「I feel like I can do anything.」

name: Azel
message: 「Yeah. I think so too.」
God surely loves us.

name: Azel
message: 「Long, long ago, the Lord created a world where only angels lived.」

name: Azel
message: 「Perhaps He thought that if there were only a single race, no conflict would arise.」

name: Azel
message: 「However, the angels split into two factions--spiritual angels and material angels--and began to fight.」

name: Azel
message: 「Grieved by the conflict that only grew in cruelty, the Lord divided the world into two--Heaven and the Demon World--and created the Human World as the boundary between them.」

name: Azel
message: 「The material angels moved to the Demon World and became demons, while humans filled the surface.」

name: Azel
message: 「Thinking that conflict would now disappear, the Lord breathed a sigh of relief.」

name: Azel
message: 「However, as the price for being divided into three realms, the world became unstable, and a force was born to return it to its original state. That is Re-Crea.」

name: Azel
message: 「Moreover, the three--angels, demons, and humans--never tried to get along, and the world fell into utter chaos.」

name: Azel
message: 「Terrifying magic, Spirit Arts, and thermonuclear weapons flew about, and lives were lost like dust.」

name: Azel
message: 「The Lord grieved over the disordered world and, unable to bear watching it, resolved to destroy the world.」

name: Azel
message: 「And so He sent down the greatest Re-Crea in history.」

name: Azel
message: 「Yet even in the midst of such a crisis, the three did not cease their fighting, going so far as to view even Re-Crea as a golden opportunity to wipe out their enemies.」

name: Azel
message: 「Shutting their eyes to the inconvenient truth that everything would perish, and twisting it to claim that only they, the chosen ones, would survive.」

name: Azel
message: 「When people of conscience across the three realms were nearly consumed by despair that ruin was inevitable, their wish took form, and the Demon Lord appeared.」

name: Azel
message: 「With the power born from the will of this world--the will that refused destruction--the Demon Lord confronted Re-Crea.」

name: Azel
message: 「The Demon Lord showed the way, cooperated with good-hearted angels, demons, and humans, and saved the world.」

name: Azel
message: 「That pleased the Lord for a time, yet it was not enough to erase His despair and distrust toward His creations.」

name: Azel
message: 「Left in the world were the Demon Lord, who was the Lord's hope, and Re-Crea, which was the Lord's despair.」

name: Azel
message: 「Since then, the world faced Re-Crea many times, and each time, the Demon Lord saved the world. The Lord's heart wavered between despair and hope.」

name: Azel
message: 「However, even though the Demon Lord kept showing the path of coexistence, angels, demons, and humans did not get along.」

name: Azel
message: 「Most of them, just as before, viewed Re-Crea as nothing more than an opportunity to pursue profit.」

name: Azel
message: 「Therefore, to put an end to hope and despair, the Lord prepared an extraordinarily massive Re-Crea.」

name: Azel
message: 「He bestowed the power of Re-Crea upon the most hidebound, convention-bound angel in this world.」

name: Azel
message: 「He bound the cooperation of the three races--something that should have only been possible through the Demon Lord--solely by mutual self-interest, creating a fake Demon Lord.」

name: Azel
message: 「The Lord was testing whether the world would still endure even then.」

name: Azel
message: 「And the world continues.」

name: Azel
message: 「The Lord was satisfied with the three races for overcoming even the greatest Re-Crea.」

name: Azel
message: 「That is probably why things ended without incident this time.」

name: Azel
message: 「Surely, many things will still happen from now on. But in the end, it will go well.」

name: Azel
message: 「It will definitely go well.」

name: Azel
message: 「I believe so.」

name: Azel
message: 「That day. The light that poured down was gentle and warm.」

name: Azel
message: 「I think that is because the Lord loves this world. I want to think so.」

name: Azel
message: 「No, I believe it.」

name: Azel
message: 「Besides, this world is.」

name: Azel
message: 「A world where hope and despair.」

name: Azel
message: 「The Demon Lord and Re-Crea.」

name: Azel
message: 「Synn and I.」

name: Azel
message: 「Can all fit happily inside a single photograph.」
